articles.title_en: How Do Institutions of Higher Education Affect Local Invention? Evidence from the Establishment of US Colleges
articles.title_cn: 高等教育机构如何影响本地发明？来自美国大学设立的证据
articles.abstract_en: I use narrative historical data on site selection decisions for a subset of US colleges to identify runner-up locations that were strongly considered to become the sites of new colleges. Using runner-up counties as counterfactuals in a difference-in-difference model, I find that establishing a college causes 62 percent more patents per year. Linking patents to novel college yearbook data reveals that only 12 percent of patents in a college’s county came from that college’s alumni or faculty. I find only small differences in patenting between establishing colleges and establishing other institutions as well as between colleges with different focuses on technical fields. (JEL I23, N31, N32, N71, N72, O31, O34)
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用美国部分大学选址决策的叙事性历史数据，识别出曾被强烈考虑作为新大学校址的亚军地点。在双重差分模型中使用亚军县作为反事实，我发现设立一所大学每年会使专利数量增加62%。将专利与新颖的大学年鉴数据联系起来，结果显示，在大学所在县的专利中，仅有12%来自该大学的校友或教师。我发现，设立大学与设立其他机构之间，以及侧重技术领域的不同大学之间，在专利产出上仅存在微小差异。(JEL I23, N31, N32, N71, N72, O31, O34)

articles.title_en: The Health Impacts of Hospital Delivery Practices
articles.title_cn: 医院分娩实践的健康影响
articles.abstract_en: Treatment practices vary widely across hospitals, often with little connection to patients’ medical needs. We assess impacts of these differences in delivery practices at childbirth. We find that infants quasi-randomly delivered at hospitals with higher C-section rates are born in better shape and are less likely to be readmitted, with suggestive evidence of improved survival. These benefits are driven by avoidance of prolonged labors that pose risks to infant health. In contrast, these infants are more likely to visit the emergency department for respiratory-related problems, consistent with a large observational literature linking C-section to chronic reductions in respiratory health. (JEL I11, I12, J13, J16)
articles.abstract_cn: 不同医院的治疗实践差异很大，往往与患者的医疗需求关系不大。我们评估了这些分娩实践差异对分娩结果的影响。我们发现，在剖宫产率较高的医院准随机分娩的婴儿出生时状况更好，再入院的可能性更低，并有提示性证据表明生存率有所提高。这些益处源于避免了威胁婴儿健康的产程延长。相比之下，这些婴儿因呼吸相关问题就诊急诊科的可能性更高，这与大量将剖宫产与慢性呼吸健康下降联系起来的观察性文献一致。(JEL I11, I12, J13, J16)

articles.title_en: Optimal Income Taxation with Spillovers from Employer Learning
articles.title_cn: 雇主学习溢出效应下的最优所得税
articles.abstract_en: I study optimal income taxation when human capital investment is imperfectly observable by employers. In the model, Bayesian inference about worker productivity compresses the wage distribution, lowering the private return to human capital investment. An externality arises: given the same information, employers are more optimistic about each individual if workers are generally more productive. The significance of this externality hinges on the accuracy of employers’ beliefs and the responsiveness of human capital. For the United States, taking it into account lowers optimal marginal tax rates for most workers, reducing them by a maximum of 9–13 percentage points between $50,000 and $100,000. (JEL D83, H21, H24, J24, J31, M51, M52)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了当雇主无法完全观察人力资本投资时的最优所得税。在模型中，关于工人生产率的贝叶斯推断压缩了工资分布，降低了人力资本投资的私人回报。由此产生一种外部性：在信息相同的情况下，如果工人普遍更具生产力，雇主对每个个体的看法会更加乐观。这种外部性的重要性取决于雇主信念的准确性和人力资本的响应性。对于美国而言，考虑到这一点，大多数工人的最优边际税率会降低，在9万至13万美元之间最多降低50000-100000个百分点。（JEL D83, H21, H24, J24, J31, M51, M52）

articles.title_cn: 养老金与生育：微观经济证据
articles.abstract_en: This study identifies the causal effect of pension generosity on women’s fertility behavior. It capitalizes on Brazil’s expansion of the pension system to rural workers, whose pension wealth subsequently more than tripled. Difference-in-difference, instrumental variable, and event study methods show that the pension reform reduces the propensity of childbearing of women of fertile age by 8 percent in the short run. Completed fertility declines by 1.3 children within 20 years after the reform, reducing the contribution base of the pay-as-you-go long run. The fertility response is strongest at higher birth parities, among older women, and among mothers with sons. (JEL H55, I38, J13, J16, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究识别了养老金慷慨程度对女性生育行为的因果效应。研究利用巴西将养老金体系扩展至农村劳动者，其养老金财富随后增长超过两倍。双重差分、工具变量和事件研究法表明，养老金改革在短期内使育龄女性生育倾向降低8%。改革后20年内，完成生育率下降1.3个孩子，减少了现收现付制的长期缴费基数。生育反应在较高胎次、年长女性以及有儿子的母亲中最为强烈。(JEL H55, I38, J13, J16, O15)

articles.title_en: Profiting from Most-Favored-Customer Procurement Rules: Evidence from Medicaid
articles.title_cn: 从最惠顾客采购规则中获利：来自医疗补助的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using a difference-in-difference approach, we find that an increase to Medicaid’s minimum drug rebate under the Affordable Care Act in 2010 lowered non-Medicaid drug spending by 2.5 percent. A stylized bargaining model shows that this is likely driven by the interaction of this reform with Medicaid’s “most-favored customer” clause (MFCC). By examining the response of drugs that faced a change in incentives equivalent to the removal of Medicaid’s MFCC, we estimate that removing the Medicaid MFCC would have reduced overall 2010 non-Medicaid drug spending by an additional 3.5 percent, though it would have likely also increased Medicaid spending. (JEL C78, H51, I18, I38, L65)
articles.abstract_cn: 采用双重差分方法，我们发现《平价医疗法案》在2010年提高医疗补助最低药品回扣，使非医疗补助药品支出降低了2.5%。一个程式化的议价模型表明，这很可能由该改革与医疗补助的“最惠顾客”条款（MFCC）的相互作用所驱动。通过考察那些面临等同于取消医疗补助MFCC激励变化的药品的反应，我们估计取消医疗补助MFCC将使2010年非医疗补助药品支出额外减少3.5%，尽管这也可能增加医疗补助支出。（JEL C78, H51, I18, I38, L65）

articles.title_en: No Spending without Representation: School Boards and the Racial Gap in Education Finance
articles.title_cn: 没有代表就没有支出：学校董事会与教育财政中的种族差距
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides causal evidence that greater minority representation on school boards translates into greater investment in minority students. Focusing on California school boards, I instrument for minority (specifically, Hispanic) representation using random ballot ordering and leverage new data from a statewide capital investment program to capture intradistrict resource allocations. I show that Hispanic board members invest the marginal dollar in high-Hispanic schools within their districts. High-Hispanic schools also exhibit gains in student achievement and decreased teacher turnover. I conclude that enhancing minority representation on school boards could help combat long-standing disparities in education. JEL (H75, I21, I22, I24, J15)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了因果证据，表明学校董事会中少数族裔代表性的增加会转化为对少数族裔学生的更多投资。以加利福尼亚州学校董事会为研究对象，我利用随机选票排序作为少数族裔（特别是西班牙裔）代表性的工具变量，并利用全州资本投资计划的新数据来捕捉学区内的资源分配。我表明，西班牙裔董事会成员将边际美元投资于其学区内的西班牙裔高占比学校。西班牙裔高占比学校的学生成绩也有所提高，教师流动率下降。我得出结论，增强学校董事会中的少数族裔代表性有助于解决长期存在的教育差距。JEL（H75，I21，I22，I24，J15）

articles.title_en: Does Pay Transparency Affect the Gender Wage Gap? Evidence from Austria
articles.title_cn: 薪酬透明度是否影响性别工资差距？来自奥地利的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the 2011 Austrian pay transparency law, which requires firms above a size threshold to publish internal reports on the gender pay gap. Using an event-study design, we show that the policy had no discernible effects on male and female wages, thus leaving the gender wage gap unchanged. The effects are precisely estimated, and we rule out that the policy narrowed the gender wage gap by more than 0.4 p.p.. Moreover, we do not find evidence for wage compression within establishments. We discuss several possible reasons why the reform did not reduce the gender wage gap. (JEL J16, J31, J71, K31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2011年奥地利的薪酬透明度法律，该法律要求超过规模门槛的企业发布关于性别工资差距的内部报告。使用事件研究设计，我们表明该政策对男性和女性工资没有明显影响，因此性别工资差距保持不变。这些影响被精确估计，我们排除了该政策将性别工资差距缩小超过0.4个百分点的可能性。此外，我们没有发现企业内工资压缩的证据。我们讨论了改革未能缩小性别工资差距的几个可能原因。（JEL J16, J31, J71, K31）

articles.title_en: Peer Effects in Police Use of Force
articles.title_cn: 警察使用武力中的同伴效应
articles.abstract_en: We study the link between police officers’ on-duty injuries and their peers’ force use using a network of officers who attended the police academy together through a random lottery. On-duty injuries increase the probability of officers using force by 7 percent in the subsequent week. Officers are also more likely to injure suspects and receive complaints about neglecting victims and violating constitutional rights. The effect is concentrated in a narrow time window following the event and is not associated with significantly lower injury risk to the officer. Together, these findings suggest that emotional responses drive the effects rather than social learning. (JEL H76, J28, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用通过随机抽签共同进入警察学院的警官网络，研究了警官执勤受伤与其同伴使用武力之间的联系。执勤受伤会使警官在随后一周内使用武力的概率增加7%。警官也更有可能伤害嫌疑人，并收到关于忽视受害者和侵犯宪法权利的投诉。这种效应集中在事件发生后的一个狭窄时间窗口内，并且与警官受伤风险的显著降低无关。总之，这些发现表明情绪反应而非社会学习驱动了这些效应。(JEL H76, J28, K42)

articles.title_en: Can Forward Commodity Markets Improve Spot Market Performance? Evidence from Wholesale Electricity
articles.title_cn: 远期商品市场能否改善现货市场表现？来自批发电力的证据
articles.abstract_en: Forward markets are believed to aggregate information about future spot prices and reduce the cost of producing the commodity. We develop a measure of the extent to which forward and spot prices agree in markets with transaction costs. Using this measure, we show that day-ahead prices better reflect real-time prices at all locations in California’s electricity market after the introduction of financial trading. We then present evidence suggesting that operating costs and input fuel use fell after the introduction of financial trading on days when the nonconvexities inherent to the production and transmission of electricity are especially relevant. (JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48)
articles.abstract_cn: 远期市场被认为能够聚合关于未来现货价格的信息，并降低商品的生产成本。我们开发了一种衡量在存在交易成本的市场中远期价格与现货价格一致程度的指标。利用该指标，我们表明在引入金融交易后，加州电力市场中日前价格在所有地点更好地反映了实时价格。随后，我们提供的证据表明，在电力生产和传输固有的非凸性尤为相关的日子里，引入金融交易后运营成本和投入燃料使用量有所下降。（JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48）

articles.title_en: Borrowing Costs after Sovereign Debt Relief
articles.title_cn: 主权债务减免后的借贷成本
articles.abstract_en: Can debt moratoria help countries weather negative shocks? We exploit the Debt Service Suspension Initiative (DSSI) to study the bond market effects of deferring official debt repayments. Using daily data on sovereign bond spreads and synthetic control methods, we show that countries eligible for official debt relief experience a larger decline in borrowing costs compared to similar, ineligible countries. This decline is stronger for countries that receive a larger relief, suggesting that the effect works through liquidity provision. By contrast, the results do not support the concern that official debt relief could generate stigma on financial markets. (JEL F34, G12, H63, O16)
articles.abstract_cn: 债务暂停能否帮助国家抵御负面冲击？我们利用债务服务暂停倡议（DSSI）来研究推迟官方债务偿还对债券市场的影响。使用主权债券利差的日度数据和合成控制方法，我们表明，与类似的不符合条件国家相比，符合官方债务减免条件的国家借贷成本下降幅度更大。对于获得更大减免的国家，这种下降更为显著，表明该效应通过流动性供给发挥作用。相比之下，结果不支持官方债务减免可能在金融市场上产生污名效应的担忧。（JEL F34, G12, H63, O16）

articles.title_en: Ask and You Shall Receive? Gender Differences in Regrades in College
articles.title_cn: 有求必应？大学成绩复议中的性别差异
articles.abstract_en: Using administrative data from a large public university, we show that male students are 18.6 percent more likely than female students to receive favorable grade changes made by instructors. Surveys of students and instructors reveal that regrade requests are prevalent and that male students are more likely to ask for regrades on the intensive margin. We corroborate the gender differences in regrade requests in an incentivized controlled experiment: we find that males have a higher willingness to pay to ask for regrades. Almost a third of the gender difference is due to gender differences in beliefs and the Big Five traits. (JEL D82, D91, I23, J16)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用一所大型公立大学的行政数据，我们表明，男生获得教师有利成绩更改的可能性比女生高18.6%。对学生和教师的调查显示，成绩复议请求普遍存在，且男生在集约边际上更可能提出复议请求。我们在一个激励性对照实验中证实了复议请求中的性别差异：我们发现，男性为请求复议而支付的意愿更高。性别差异中近三分之一归因于信念和大五人格特质的性别差异。(JEL D82, D91, I23, J16)

articles.title_en: Climate Change and Labor Reallocation: Evidence from Six Decades of the Indian Census
articles.title_cn: 气候变化与劳动力重新配置：来自印度人口普查六十年的证据
articles.abstract_en: How do rising temperatures affect long-term labor reallocation in developing economies? In this paper we examine how increases in temperature impact structural transformation and urbanization within Indian districts between 1951 and 2011. We find that rising temperatures are associated with lower shares of workers in nonagricultural sectors, with effects intensifying over a longer time frame. Supporting evidence suggests that local demand effects play an important role: declining agricultural productivity under higher temperatures reduces the demand for nonagricultural goods and services, which subsequently lowers nonagricultural labor demand. Our results illustrate that rising temperatures limit sectoral and rural-urban mobility for isolated households. (JEL J61, N35, O13, O15, O18, Q54, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 气温上升如何影响发展中经济体的长期劳动力重新配置？在本文中，我们研究了1951年至2011年间气温上升对印度各地区结构转型和城市化的影响。我们发现，气温上升与非农业部门工人占比下降相关，且这种影响在更长的时间范围内加剧。支持性证据表明，地方需求效应发挥着重要作用：高温下农业生产力下降减少了对非农业商品和服务的需求，进而降低了非农业劳动力需求。我们的结果表明，气温上升限制了孤立家庭在部门间和城乡间的流动性。（JEL J61, N35, O13, O15, O18, Q54, R23）

articles.title_en: Taxing Billionaires: Estate Taxes and the Geographical Location of the Ultra-Wealthy
articles.title_cn: 对亿万富翁征税：遗产税与超级富豪的地理位置
articles.abstract_en: We contribute to the literature on the effect of taxes on the locational choices of wealthy individuals by examining the geographical sensitivity of the Forbes 400 richest Americans to state estate taxes. Though we find billionaires’ effective tax rates are only about half the statutory rate, their residential choices are highly sensitive to these taxes, as 35 percent of local billionaires leave states with an estate tax. This tax-induced mobility causes a large reduction in the aggregate tax base. Nonetheless, we find that the revenue benefit of an estate tax exceeds the cost for the vast majority of states. (JEL H24, H31, H71, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过考察福布斯400位最富有的美国人对州遗产税的地理敏感性，为关于税收对富人区位选择影响的文献做出贡献。尽管我们发现亿万富翁的有效税率仅为法定税率的一半左右，但他们的居住选择对这些税收高度敏感，因为35%的本地亿万富翁会离开征收遗产税的州。这种由税收引起的流动性导致总税基大幅减少。尽管如此，我们发现对于绝大多数州而言，遗产税的收入收益超过了成本。(JEL H24, H31, H71, R23)

articles.abstract_en: Chinese local leaders are frequently moved across prefectures. By combining local leader rotation data and comprehensive firm land parcel purchase data across prefectures from 2006 to 2016, this paper examines how firm–politician connections affect resource allocation and finds that a firm headquartered in a leader’s previous work prefecture purchases three times more land parcels in that leader’s new governing prefecture than the prefecture-year mean, at half the unit prices. Identification is from within-firm-year variation in various prefectures through exogenous politician rotation. Land usage efficiency is lower for these follower firms’ land parcels. Land allocation distortion is also economically sizable. (JEL D22, D72, O17, O18, P25, P26)
articles.abstract_cn: 中国地方领导人经常在各地级市之间调动。通过结合地方领导人轮换数据和2006年至2016年间各地级市的企业土地购置综合数据，本文研究了企业与政治家之间的联系如何影响资源配置，并发现总部位于领导人先前工作地级市的企业，在该领导人新任地级市购买的土地地块数量是地级市年均水平的三倍，而单位价格仅为一半。识别策略来自通过外生政治家轮换引起的同一企业在不同地级市的年内变化。这些追随企业的土地地块的土地利用效率较低。土地配置扭曲在经济规模上也是显著的。(JEL D22, D72, O17, O18, P25, P26)

articles.title_en: Externalities in International Tax Enforcement: Theory and Evidence
articles.title_cn: 国际税收执法中的外部性：理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: We show that the fiscal authorities of high-tax countries can lack the incentives to combat profit shifting to tax havens. Instead, they have incentives to focus their enforcement efforts on relocating profits booked by multinationals in other high-tax countries, crowding out the enforcement on transactions that shift profits to tax havens, and reducing the global tax payments of multinational companies. The predictions of our model are motivated and supported by the analysis of two new datasets: the universe of transfer price corrections conducted by the Danish tax authority, and new cross-country data on international tax enforcement. (JEL E62, F23, H25, H26, H87, K34)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，高税收国家的财政当局可能缺乏打击利润转移至避税天堂的激励。相反，他们有激励将执法工作重点放在重新定位跨国公司在其他高税收国家入账的利润上，从而挤出了对将利润转移至避税天堂的交易执法，并减少了跨国公司的全球纳税额。我们模型的预测得到了两个新数据集分析的支持和激励：丹麦税务机关进行的转让定价调整全集，以及关于国际税收执法的新的跨国数据。（JEL E62, F23, H25, H26, H87, K34）

articles.title_en: Coase and Cap-and-Trade: Evidence on the Independence Property from the European Carbon Market
articles.title_cn: 科斯与总量管制与交易：来自欧洲碳市场独立性属性的证据
articles.abstract_en: I examine the Coasean independence property in a large multinational cap-and-trade scheme for greenhouse gas emissions, the EU Emissions Trading System. I analyze whether emissions of power producers are independent from allowance allocations by leveraging a change in allocation policy for a difference-in-difference strategy. The evidence suggests that the independence property holds overall and for larger emitters and that firms respond to the loss in allocation by increasing allowance purchases. Suggestive evidence for small emitters indicates that trading costs or behavioral bias distorts their emission decisions. However, their small emission share leaves the independence property intact at the sector level. (JEL L94, L98, Q48, Q51, Q54, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了科斯独立性属性在一个大型跨国温室气体排放总量管制与交易计划——欧盟排放交易体系中的表现。我通过利用分配政策的变化进行双重差分策略，分析了电力生产者的排放是否独立于配额分配。证据表明，独立性属性总体上成立，对于较大排放者也是如此，并且企业通过增加配额购买来应对分配损失。对小排放者的提示性证据表明，交易成本或行为偏差扭曲了他们的排放决策。然而，他们的排放份额较小，使得独立性属性在部门层面保持不变。(JEL L94, L98, Q48, Q51, Q54, Q58)
